foundation_schema_validation.comparison: Token-aware SQLite DDL canonicalization; ignores whitespace and comments; preserves string literal spelling; uses ASCII-only identifier case normalization; checks table_xinfo, foreign keys, explicit and automatic index layouts and migration-defined SQL.
foundation_schema_validation.baseline_write_order: Reject drift during read-only preflight before backup or registry write; exact untracked Foundation schema may be baselined with applied_at NULL.
foundation_schema_validation.retained_legacy_tables: Expected to remain; rows are not rewritten.

backup_restore.unknown_provenance_policy: Fail closed; use documented offline/manual recovery reviewed against intended target and source fingerprints.

migration_compatibility.legacy_positive_amount: Preserved; exposed by the Migration 003 uncertainty view as raw_legacy_amount with NULL currency and UNKNOWN basis; no trusted price absent an approved independently verified supported-currency review.

unresolved_risks: Migration 003 has not been independently reviewed or applied to production.
The per-user manifest signing key must be preserved; key loss makes automated restore fail closed, and key compromise weakens manifest provenance.
The writers-stopped flag is an operator acknowledgment, not proof of zero active writers.
Backups created before manifest signing cannot gain provenance retroactively and require the documented manual recovery procedure.
